note: Westview (owner, 8 November 2026: 'yes do both'): Ralph Bohner's ties, and the Westview residents WandaVision names, checked against the episodes (Wikipedia episode plots, the MCU wiki)

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Cast by Agatha as Wanda's dead brother Pietro, Ralph turns up at her door looking different, and she hugs him and lets him in.
stages.whoA: Takes him in as her brother Pietro.
stages.whoB: Her brother Pietro, though he looks different.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: On Halloween he presses Wanda on how she made the Hex, and when he jokes that Vision can't die twice, she blasts him away.
stages.whoA: Doubts him, and blasts him away on Halloween.
stages.whoB: A Pietro who pries into how she made the Hex.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: As their uncle, he chases Billy and Tommy around the house at super speed and takes them trick-or-treating.
stages.whoA: His nephew, taken trick-or-treating.
stages.whoB: Uncle Pietro, who chases him at super speed.

stages.title: Agatha All Along
stages.text: Years later Billy, now Billy Kaplan, pays Ralph to tell him what he remembers of Westview.
stages.whoA: Pays him for his memories of Westview.
stages.whoB: Westview's fake Pietro, who sells him what he remembers.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: As their uncle, he chases Tommy and Billy at super speed, and is delighted when Tommy turns out fast too.
stages.whoA: His nephew, who turns out fast like him.
stages.whoB: Uncle Pietro, fast like him.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Arriving as Wanda's brother, Ralph meets a puzzled Vision at the door and asks who he is.
stages.whoA: His brother-in-law, puzzled by him.
stages.whoB: Wanda's brother Pietro, newly arrived.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Agatha reveals that the Pietro she sent Wanda is her puppet.
stages.whoA: Controls him, and cast him as Pietro.
stages.whoB: Her puppet, sent to Wanda as Pietro.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: He catches Monica snooping in Agnes's basement.
stages.whoA: Caught her snooping in Agnes's house.
stages.whoB: The fake Pietro, who catches her snooping.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Monica pulls off his necklace, breaking Agatha's hold, and learns he is Ralph Bohner.
stages.whoA: Freed him from Agatha's spell.
stages.whoB: Ralph Bohner, freed by her from Agatha's spell.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Sarah and Harold are married; the Hex casts them as Dottie and Phil Jones.
stages.whoA: Her husband, cast as Phil Jones.
stages.whoB: His wife, cast as Dottie Jones.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: As Dottie, she warns Wanda about rumours after the committee meeting, then hosts the talent show and hands Wanda and Vision the award.
stages.whoA: The newcomer she warns, then gives an award.
stages.whoB: Dottie, queen bee of the committee.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Freed by Agatha, Sarah begs Wanda to free her daughter; Wanda chokes the crowd before she lets them go.
stages.whoA: Held her and her town in the Hex.
stages.whoB: A Westview mother she held in the Hex.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: As Dottie and Beverly, they run the talent show committee, and Dottie scolds Beverly for forgetting the chairs.
stages.whoA: Beverly, her friend on the committee.
stages.whoB: Dottie, who runs the committee.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: As Phil Jones, he's in the neighbourhood watch Vision joins, and plays piano at the talent show.
stages.whoA: Joins his neighbourhood watch.
stages.whoB: Phil Jones, of the neighbourhood watch.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Freed by Agatha, he begs Wanda for release with the other townspeople, and is choked before she lets them go.
stages.whoA: Held him and his town in the Hex.
stages.whoB: A Westview piano teacher she held in the Hex.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: As Herb, he meets Vision at the neighbourhood watch and gives him the gum that leaves Vision acting drunk.
stages.whoA: Joins the watch, and takes his gum.
stages.whoB: Herb, his neighbour on the watch.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Herb trims his hedge straight through the wall between their driveways, and starts telling Vision that Geraldine doesn't live in Westview until Agnes cuts him off.
stages.whoA: His neighbour, puzzled by the wall.
stages.whoB: Herb, who trims through their wall.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Gossiping with Agnes, Herb starts telling Vision that Geraldine doesn't live in Westview, and Agnes cuts him off.
stages.whoA: Agnes, the neighbour he gossips with.
stages.whoB: Herb, a neighbour she gossips with.

stages.title: Agatha All Along
stages.text: Spellbound as Agnes for three years, she takes him for a forensics expert; freed, she turns up naked in his driveway and calls him a coward for not saying Wanda's name.
stages.whoA: Agnes, spellbound for three years, then herself again.
stages.whoB: The neighbour she calls a coward.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: On Halloween, Herb tells Wanda that Vision isn't on neighbourhood watch duty that night.
stages.whoA: His neighbour, told Vision isn't on duty.
stages.whoB: Herb, her neighbour.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Freed by Agatha, he joins the townspeople begging Wanda to let them go; she chokes them before she releases them.
stages.whoA: Held him and his town in the Hex.
stages.whoB: A Westview man she held in the Hex.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: As Norm, he works alongside Vision at Computational Services Inc.
stages.whoA: His coworker at Computational Services.
stages.whoB: Norm, his coworker.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Vision breaks his trance; Abilash, frantic about his sister and his father, begs Vision to make her stop, and Vision puts him back.
stages.whoA: Broke his trance, then put him back.
stages.whoB: Abilash, the man behind Norm.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Freed by Agatha, he begs Wanda to let him see his family; she chokes the crowd before she releases them.
stages.whoA: Held him and his town in the Hex.
stages.whoB: A Westview man she held in the Hex.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: As Norm, he works for Mr. Hart at Computational Services Inc.
stages.whoA: His boss, Mr. Hart.
stages.whoB: Norm, one of his staff.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Freed by Agatha, she begs Wanda to let her go; Wanda chokes the crowd before she releases them.
stages.whoA: Held her and her town in the Hex.
stages.whoB: A Westview woman she held in the Hex.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: As Mr. Hart, Vision's boss, he comes to dinner, threatens Vision's job when the couple can't answer questions about their past, then chokes, and Vision saves him.
stages.whoA: His employee, who saves him from choking.
stages.whoB: His boss, Mr. Hart.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Married, they play Mr. and Mrs. Hart, Vision's boss and his wife.
stages.whoA: His wife, Mrs. Hart.
stages.whoB: Her husband, Mr. Hart.
